==About me==

Hey all, I'm Arkady...I'm 13, Asian, female, and in 9th grade...I'm your local spelling nazi and typo-fixer. Hope to see you all around soon!

My favorite characters are Nynaeve, Lan, Rand, Aviendha, Min, Mat, Tuon, the Aiel (except for the Shaido--ugh), and the Forsaken. I dislike Elayne, Perrin, Gawyn, and Faile, and do not even mention Egwene in my presence. She's an insufferable know-it-all without any redeeming traits whatsoever.

I like some aspects of Jordan's books and some of Sanderson's; however, Elayne, Perrin, Faile, Egwene, and Gawyn have become more bearable in Sanderson's. I don't know if that's a good thing or not. I'm thinking not, as I liked disliking them.

Aside from Wheel of Time, I enjoy Stargate: SG-1 and Atlantis, Star Trek: TOS and TNG, Star Wars, Firefly, A Song of Ice and Fire, Lord of the Rings, Dragonriders of Pern, X-Men, Dune (original), Avatar: The Last Airbender, and too many other fandoms to name.
